claim: The Pigment CSS repo itself declares the project is in alpha and on hold, though it is not archived (1,124 stars, 148 open issues, last push 2026-06-06).
quote: ⚠️ 𝐀𝐥𝐩𝐡𝐚 𝐩𝐡𝐚𝐬𝐞, currently, on hold. Pigment CSS is a zero-runtime CSS-in-JS library that extracts the colocated styles to their own CSS files at build time.

claim: MUI officially stated on 1 Jan 2026 that Pigment CSS development is paused and that resources were redirected to Base UI.
quote: Pigment CSS remains in alpha phase and is currently on hold. ... Pigment CSS is not being developed at the moment. While we still believe in the potential of the ideas behind it, progressing further would require a different approach.

claim: Material UI v9 shipped 8 Apr 2026 still on Emotion; removing the Emotion dependency is listed only under 'What's next', and the release claims ~3% bundle reduction vs v7 and up to 30% faster sx.
quote: Remove dependency on Emotion. Performance improvements. Accessibility improvements. Add more components from Base UI. ... roughly 3% bundle size reduction compared to v7 ... `sx` prop performance improvements up to 30% for heavy `sx` usage

claim: The latest Material UI stable is 9.2.0 (3 Jul 2026); MUI skipped v8 entirely, going 7.0.0 (26 Mar 2025) straight to 9.0.0 (7 Apr 2026), and Emotion is an optional peer dependency alongside an optional @mui/material-pigment-css peer.
quote: dist-tags: {latest: 9.2.0, latest-v7: 7.3.11, latest-v6: 6.5.0, latest-v5: 5.18.0, next: 9.0.0-beta.1}; peerDependenciesMeta: @emotion/react optional, @emotion/styled optional, @mui/material-pigment-css optional

claim: Emotion is still the de facto runtime engine in MUI v9: @mui/styled-engine 9.1.1 hard-depends on @emotion/cache, @emotion/serialize and @emotion/sheet.
quote: "dependencies": {"@emotion/cache": "^11.14.0", "@emotion/serialize": "^1.3.3", "@emotion/sheet": "^1.4.0", ...}

claim: Pigment CSS shipped v0.0.30 in Jan 2025 and then nothing for 16 months until a maintenance-only v0.0.31 on 22 May 2026; the last commit (6 Jun 2026) is an internal repo-normalization chore.
quote: v0.0.31 published=2026-05-22T06:18:42Z; v0.0.30 published=2025-01-14T09:43:44Z; v0.0.29 published=2024-12-24; commits: 2026-06-06 [internal] Normalization between repositories, 2026-05-22 v0.0.31 (#421), 2026-05-22 [nextjs] add to support next.js 16 (#414)

claim: An open MUI issue titled 'What is the way forward for styling @ mui?' (opened 30 Mar 2025) captures community frustration that v7 still ships Emotion while Pigment stalled.
quote: mui7 out last week is still sticking with emotion ... no proper release / upgrade path yet for pigment and looks like it is undergoing major refactor

claim: Material UI has an official, first-party Tailwind CSS v4 integration built on CSS cascade layers via enableCssLayer.
quote: ensures Material UI styles are wrapped in `@layer mui`, which allows Tailwind CSS v4 utilities to override them predictably ... @layer theme, base, mui, components, utilities;

claim: MUI v9.2.0 emits five modular cascade layers (mui.global, mui.components, mui.theme, mui.custom, mui.sx) when modularCssLayers is enabled.
quote: @layer mui.global: Global styles from the GlobalStyles and CssBaseline components. @layer mui.components: Base styles for all Material UI components. @layer mui.theme ... @layer mui.custom ... @layer mui.sx: Styles from the sx prop.

claim: The @layer/Tailwind-v4 specificity fix was tracked in issue #44700 (now closed, shipped via PR #45906) and was motivated by MUI components outranking Tailwind utilities.
quote: The current Material UI v6 is hard to use with CSS utilities like Tailwind CSS because some components have higher CSS specificity than (0,1,0) so Tailwind CSS could not be used without `!important`.

claim: MUI ships an official agent skill for MUI+Tailwind that requires cssVariables: true so --mui-* tokens can be reused inside Tailwind's @theme.
quote: MUI CSS theme variables (`cssVariables: true` in `createTheme`) so the `--mui-*` variables exist ... @layer theme, base, mui, components, utilities; @import 'tailwindcss';

claim: CSS theme variables in MUI are enabled with createTheme({ cssVariables: true }) and consumed through the normal ThemeProvider.
quote: const theme = createTheme({ cssVariables: true });

claim: The v9 migration guide contains no styling-engine change: breaking changes are deprecated CSS classes, removed system props and theme component types, not a move off Emotion.
quote: The deprecated system props have been removed from the following components: Box, DialogContentText, Grid, Link, Stack, Typography, TimelineContent, TimelineOppositeContent.

claim: Base UI hit stable v1.0 on 11 Dec 2025, v1.1 on 15 Jan 2026 and v1.6.0 on 17 Jun 2026, and is explicitly styling-engine agnostic.
quote: Unstyled. Compatible with any styling engine.

claim: Base UI (MUI's unstyled component library, co-maintained with Radix and Floating UI contributors) has 10,336 stars and is actively pushed (2026-07-14).
quote: mui/base-ui: stars=10336 open_issues=403 archived=false pushed=2026-07-14T08:14:32Z

claim: In July 2026 shadcn/ui made Base UI its default primitive library, replacing Radix as the default (Radix still supported).
quote: Starting today, Base UI is the default component library in shadcn/ui. ... Radix is not being deprecated. We still support it, and every update and new component will ship for both libraries.

claim: InfoQ reported (Feb 2026) that MUI released Base UI 1.0 with 35 accessible unstyled components and a long-term maintenance commitment.
quote: MUI Releases Base UI 1 with 35 Accessible Components

claim: Emotion downloads are flat-to-declining (10M in 2023 to 9.1M in 2026, held up mainly by MUI) while Tailwind doubled to 12M; Emotion adds ~15KB of runtime.
quote: Emotion: 2023: 10M → 2024: 9.5M → 2026: 9.1M (-9%, more stable due to MUI) ... Tailwind CSS: 2023: 6M → 2024: 9M → 2026: 12M (+100% over 3 years) ... Emotion: ~15KB

claim: The enableCssLayer prop was added to StyledEngineProvider by MUI maintainer siriwatknp, wiring Emotion output into @layer mui.
quote: [styled-engine] Add `enableCssLayer` prop to StyledEngineProvider

claim: The 'Status of project' discussion on the Pigment CSS repo is the community's long-running thread asking for updates, with no substantive team roadmap answer beyond pointers to other threads.
quote: Status of project · mui/pigment-css · Discussion #249

claim: MUI documents Emotion as the default style engine, with styled-components as a swappable alternative.
quote: By default, Material UI components come with Emotion as their style engine.

claim: Emotion itself remains maintained but slow-moving (18,019 stars, last push 2026-05-06).
quote: emotion-js/emotion: stars=18019 open_issues=382 archived=false pushed=2026-05-06T07:42:22Z
